title: Stripe Fee Calculator (2026 Domestic & Cross-Border)
meta_description: Calculate exact Stripe processing fees, international card surcharges, currency conversion fees, and reverse invoice amounts to net your target payout.
lead: Instantly compute Stripe fees and net payouts, or reverse-calculate how much to bill clients so you receive an exact target payout.

options.label: Forward — Enter invoice total to see net payout
Reverse — Enter target net payout to see invoice total

formula_html:
Forward (Invoice → Net Payout): Fee = Gross × Rate + Fixed, and Net = Gross - Fee.

Reverse (Target Net → Invoice Total): Gross = (Target Net + Fixed) / (1 - Rate) so that after Stripe deducts its percentage on the full invoice, your payout equals the exact target net amount.

faqs.q: Why can't I just add 2.9% + $0.30 to my target net amount?
faqs.a: Stripe charges its percentage fee on the entire gross charge—including the extra fee you passed on. Using the reverse formula (Target + Fixed) / (1 - Rate) accounts for the fee-on-fee effect so you are never short.

faqs.q: When does Stripe add the 1.5% international card and 1% FX conversion fees?
faqs.a: If a US merchant accepts a card issued outside the US, Stripe adds 1.5% for international cards, plus another 1.0% if currency conversion is required.

faqs.q: Does Stripe refund processing fees when I issue a refund?
faqs.a: In most regions, Stripe does not return the original processing fees when a payment is refunded, making accurate upfront margin and fee planning critical.
